Checkout on one page, in the order things are needed: an express wallet first, then contact,
delivery and payment, with the order and its total beside them. You can check out as a guest, with
signing in only offered. Every field asks for what browsers and password managers can fill.

<Template name="checkout" />

## Try it

- Press **Pay** with nothing filled in: a list of what to fix comes up first, each item a link to
  its field.
- Pay with the card `4000 0000 0000 0002`: it's declined, the way a real one would be. Any other
  card goes through to the [confirmation](/templates/confirmation/).
- Apply the code `RESONANCE` for 10% off; choose express delivery and watch the total on the button.

## Details that matter

- **Guest by default.** Forced sign-up is one of the biggest reasons people leave a checkout.
- **The total on the button is what you pay,** with tax and shipping, and changes with every choice.
- **`autocomplete` on every field** (`email`, `shipping address-line1`, `cc-number`, `cc-exp`…), so
  most of the form fills itself. The card number groups itself as it's typed.
- **On a phone the summary folds up** to one line with the total, above the form.
